x_esd.note: format=ff10, the zip container, the *egu* member filter, and the numbered column map are not expressible in the 0.8.0 source schema (G3); the runner selects egu members and parses the columns. Records whose pollutant maps to no pathway are skipped by the runner.
x_esd.pollutant_encoding: The FF10 col-12 string code is delivered as the integer in `pollutant_codes` by the runner ff10 reader; the is_VOC/is_NOx/is_NH3/is_SOx/is_PM25 membership observeds compare `pollutant` against these integers (STEP 0.6 pollutant->pathway map).

pollutant.description: FF10 pollutant code (col 12), delivered as the `pollutant` enum integer (see x_esd).

stkdiam.description: Stack diameter (col 18), ft->m. Fidelity only; unused downstream.

stkhgt.description: Stack height (col 17), ft->m. Collected for fidelity; NOT consumed (emisLayer hard-coded to 0).

stktemp.description: Stack temperature (col 19), degF->K (F-32)*5/9+273.15. Fidelity only; unused downstream.

stkvel.description: Stack velocity (col 21), ft/s->m/s. Fidelity only; unused downstream.

gated_select._DRAFT: Phase-2-core GATED-PROVIDER field (proposed). Replaces the runner's lazy_select ([0], ppl, :). Per-axis selection over the native SR dims sr_dim_order [emisLayer, source, receptor] = [3, 52411, 52411]; one axis is GATED BY a derived (value-invention) index set. Intended consumption: the engine DEFERS this provider's materialisation until materialize_value_invention has produced the gating set's members+extent, then delivers each `applies_to` array pre-sliced to the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab BEFORE the SR contraction (no 330 GB fold). Per-axis semantics: {"fixed":[i]} = take native index i and DROP the axis; {"gated_by":"<derived index set>"} = take that set's materialised members, in the set's canonical (sorted) member order, as the new axis (here emis_src_cells = the invented ppl); "all" = full axis (slice(None)).

x_esd.note: `format` and the pinned .zarray params are not expressible in the 0.8.0 source schema (G1); the runner sets format at provider creation. PUSHDOWN DRAFT: the SR source-axis slice is no longer the runner-threaded `ppl` lazy_select but the gated_select above, gated by the DERIVED emis_src_cells set the value-invention producer emis_src_cells_faq materialises (G2; Phase-2-core gated-provider deferral). W/S/E/N/TotalPop/MortalityRate are read fully; the first 52411 (the [0:52411] prefix slice) are the SR receptor/source cells. NOTE: for the pushdown, W/S/E/N (full-grid cell rectangles) must also be available to value-invention as build-time const factors (the producer's rectangle filter reads index(W,c)..index(N,c) over the full source grid).

reference.notes: InMAP ISRM v1.2.1 zarr store on the inmap-model S3 bucket.

E.description: Cell east edge (LCC metres); length 596444, first 52411 used.

MortalityRate.description: Baseline all-cause mortality per 100,000; length 596444, prefix [0:52411] used.

N.description: Cell north edge (LCC metres); length 596444, first 52411 used.

PrimaryPM25.description: SR primary PM2.5 response (contracted with PM2_5 emissions). SR response; native dims [emis_layer, src_cells, rcv_cells] (dtype <f4, chunks [1,100,52411]). Runner delivers only the lazy orthogonal slice ([0], ppl, :) => the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab (G2).

S.description: Cell south edge (LCC metres); length 596444, first 52411 used.

SOA.description: SR secondary organic aerosol response (contracted with VOC emissions). SR response; native dims [emis_layer, src_cells, rcv_cells] (dtype <f4, chunks [1,100,52411]). Runner delivers only the lazy orthogonal slice ([0], ppl, :) => the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab (G2).

TotalPop.description: Population per cell; length 596444, prefix [0:52411] used in the deaths formula.

W.description: Cell west edge (LCC metres); length 596444, first 52411 build the cell rectangles.

pNH4.description: SR particulate ammonium response (contracted with NH3 emissions). SR response; native dims [emis_layer, src_cells, rcv_cells] (dtype <f4, chunks [1,100,52411]). Runner delivers only the lazy orthogonal slice ([0], ppl, :) => the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab (G2).

pNO3.description: SR particulate nitrate response (contracted with NOx emissions). SR response; native dims [emis_layer, src_cells, rcv_cells] (dtype <f4, chunks [1,100,52411]). Runner delivers only the lazy orthogonal slice ([0], ppl, :) => the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab (G2).

pSO4.description: SR particulate sulfate response (contracted with SOx emissions). SR response; native dims [emis_layer, src_cells, rcv_cells] (dtype <f4, chunks [1,100,52411]). Runner delivers only the lazy orthogonal slice ([0], ppl, :) => the compact [emis_src_cells, rcv_cells] slab (G2).

metadata.description: FULLY-AUTOMATIC clean full-domain InMAP ISRM (Phase 5 target). Full-domain SR[src_cells,rcv_cells], E as the emission->cell binning +-aggregate, X/Y as an in-model Lambert-conformal PROJECTION observed over raw emis_lon/emis_lat (the inline trig IS the lambert_conformal_forward_x/y expansion), projected at BUILD time by the general-eval coordinate path (Phase 5 Part A). NO hand-authored pushdown constructs (no derived set / producer / gated_select / member_factor) and NO caller-supplied projected coordinates. Builds with pushdown_rewrite=true: the auto-rewrite (Phase 4) generates the support set + distinct producer + member_factor + gated_select; the gated SR provider is fetched pre-sliced to the invented source cells. NO runner pre-pass. (Not full-scale-validated: Wall #2 type-instability in the observed evaluator is separate/pre-existing; L1-scale machine precision is the Phase-5 acceptance.)
metadata.name: ISRM_clean

references.citation: Tessum, C.W., Hill, J.D., Marshall, J.D. (2017). InMAP: A model for air pollution interventions. PLoS ONE 12(4): e0176131.

N_LAYER.description: SR emission layers (only layer 0 is used).

N_POP.description: Full InMAP grid length of W/S/E/N/TotalPop/MortalityRate.

N_RCV.description: ISRM receptor cells (== the source grid, same ordered cell set).

N_REC.description: EGU FF10 point-source record count (runtime-discovered; G6).

N_SRC.description: ISRM source cells (first-52411 coarse subset of the InMAP grid).

E.description: Cell east edge (LCC m); from ISRM_SR.E.

N.description: Cell north edge (LCC m); from ISRM_SR.N.

S.description: Cell south edge (LCC m); from ISRM_SR.S.

SR_PrimaryPM25.description: Source-receptor matrix for the PrimaryPM25 pathway (contracted with PM2_5 emissions), already emisLayer-0- and ppl-sliced by the runner's lazy zarr select ([0], ppl, :). Rows are the compact emission-bearing source cells (emis_src_cells), columns the 52411 receptors (rcv_cells). Wired from ISRM_SR.PrimaryPM25 via param_to_var (G2).

SR_SOA.description: Source-receptor matrix for the SOA pathway (contracted with VOC emissions), already emisLayer-0- and ppl-sliced by the runner's lazy zarr select ([0], ppl, :). Rows are the compact emission-bearing source cells (emis_src_cells), columns the 52411 receptors (rcv_cells). Wired from ISRM_SR.SOA via param_to_var (G2).

SR_pNH4.description: Source-receptor matrix for the pNH4 pathway (contracted with NH3 emissions), already emisLayer-0- and ppl-sliced by the runner's lazy zarr select ([0], ppl, :). Rows are the compact emission-bearing source cells (emis_src_cells), columns the 52411 receptors (rcv_cells). Wired from ISRM_SR.pNH4 via param_to_var (G2).

SR_pNO3.description: Source-receptor matrix for the pNO3 pathway (contracted with NOx emissions), already emisLayer-0- and ppl-sliced by the runner's lazy zarr select ([0], ppl, :). Rows are the compact emission-bearing source cells (emis_src_cells), columns the 52411 receptors (rcv_cells). Wired from ISRM_SR.pNO3 via param_to_var (G2).

SR_pSO4.description: Source-receptor matrix for the pSO4 pathway (contracted with SOx emissions), already emisLayer-0- and ppl-sliced by the runner's lazy zarr select ([0], ppl, :). Rows are the compact emission-bearing source cells (emis_src_cells), columns the 52411 receptors (rcv_cells). Wired from ISRM_SR.pSO4 via param_to_var (G2).

TotalPM25.description: Total PM2.5 concentration at each receptor: fact*(conc_SOA+conc_pNO3+conc_pNH4+conc_pSO4+conc_PrimaryPM25).

TotalPop.description: Population per cell; from ISRM_SR.TotalPop (read on the rcv range = [0:52411] prefix slice).

W.description: Cell west edge (LCC m); from ISRM_SR.W (full 596444, prefix used).

X.description: Lambert-conformal-conic forward-x of the raw emission coordinate (== lambert_conformal_forward_x expanded to trig). Projected at BUILD time by the general-eval coordinate path (Phase 5 Part A) — the caller supplies only raw emis_lon/emis_lat.

Y.description: Lambert-conformal-conic forward-y of the raw emission coordinate (== lambert_conformal_forward_y expanded to trig). Projected at BUILD time by the general-eval coordinate path (Phase 5 Part A) — the caller supplies only raw emis_lon/emis_lat.

conc_PrimaryPM25.description: Per-receptor concentration response from the PrimaryPM25 pathway: sum_s SR_PrimaryPM25[s,rcv]*E_PM25[s] (pre-fact; emisLayer 0 already sliced out of SR).

conc_SOA.description: Per-receptor concentration response from the SOA pathway: sum_s SR_SOA[s,rcv]*E_VOC[s] (pre-fact; emisLayer 0 already sliced out of SR).

conc_pNH4.description: Per-receptor concentration response from the pNH4 pathway: sum_s SR_pNH4[s,rcv]*E_NH3[s] (pre-fact; emisLayer 0 already sliced out of SR).

conc_pNO3.description: Per-receptor concentration response from the pNO3 pathway: sum_s SR_pNO3[s,rcv]*E_NOx[s] (pre-fact; emisLayer 0 already sliced out of SR).

conc_pSO4.description: Per-receptor concentration response from the pSO4 pathway: sum_s SR_pSO4[s,rcv]*E_SOx[s] (pre-fact; emisLayer 0 already sliced out of SR).

deathsK.description: Attributable deaths at each receptor (Krewski RR 1.06): (exp(log(rr)/10*TotalPM25)-1)*TotalPop*pop_scale*MortalityRate/100000*mort_scale. TotalPop/MortalityRate indexed on the rcv range = the [0:52411] prefix slice.

deathsL.description: Attributable deaths at each receptor (Lepeule RR 1.14): (exp(log(rr)/10*TotalPM25)-1)*TotalPop*pop_scale*MortalityRate/100000*mort_scale. TotalPop/MortalityRate indexed on the rcv range = the [0:52411] prefix slice.

fact.description: tons/year emission-unit -> ug/m3 scaling (applied once to the summed concentration).

is_NH3.description: 1 if the record's pollutant code is a NH3-class code (STEP 0.6 map), else 0.

is_NOx.description: 1 if the record's pollutant code is a NOx-class code (STEP 0.6 map), else 0.

is_PM25.description: 1 if the record's pollutant code is a PM25-class code (STEP 0.6 map), else 0.

is_SOx.description: 1 if the record's pollutant code is a SOx-class code (STEP 0.6 map), else 0.

is_VOC.description: 1 if the record's pollutant code is a VOC-class code (STEP 0.6 map), else 0.

lcc_R.description: LCC sphere radius (NEI2016). (Named lcc_R, not R, to avoid the reserved physical-constant name R = ideal gas constant.)

lcc_qp.description: pi/4 quarter-turn offset for the LCC tan half-angle.

pm_PrimaryPM25.description: Reported PrimaryPM25 PM2.5 component at each receptor: fact*conc_PrimaryPM25.

pm_SOA.description: Reported SOA PM2.5 component at each receptor: fact*conc_SOA.

pm_pNH4.description: Reported pNH4 PM2.5 component at each receptor: fact*conc_pNH4.

pm_pNO3.description: Reported pNO3 PM2.5 component at each receptor: fact*conc_pNO3.

pm_pSO4.description: Reported pSO4 PM2.5 component at each receptor: fact*conc_pSO4.

pollutant.description: Per-record FF10 pollutant code as the `pollutant` enum integer; from EGU_Emis.pollutant.

rcv_cx.description: Receptor cell-centroid easting (W+E)/2 in LCC metres.

rcv_cy.description: Receptor cell-centroid northing (S+N)/2 in LCC metres.

rr_K.description: Krewski relative risk per 10 ug/m3 PM2.5.

rr_L.description: Lepeule relative risk per 10 ug/m3 PM2.5.

src_E.description: source-cell rectangle E-edge (projected LCC meters), src_cells axis.

src_N.description: source-cell rectangle N-edge (projected LCC meters), src_cells axis.

src_S.description: source-cell rectangle S-edge (projected LCC meters), src_cells axis.

src_W.description: source-cell rectangle W-edge (projected LCC meters), src_cells axis.

stkdiam.description: Stack diameter (m); from EGU_Emis.stkdiam. Fidelity only; unused.

stkhgt.description: Stack height (m); from EGU_Emis.stkhgt. Fidelity only; ISRM never consumes it (emisLayer hard-coded to 0).

stktemp.description: Stack temperature (K); from EGU_Emis.stktemp. Fidelity only; unused.

stkvel.description: Stack velocity (m/s); from EGU_Emis.stkvel. Fidelity only; unused.
